findings.claim: MSTR 10-K FY2025 風險因素僅提及美國司法部資料安全計畫規則（2025-04-08 實施）對傳輸敏感個資至中國等『關注國家』施加類出口管制限制，及制裁／洗錢風險；未見針對關稅或實體清單的產品／供應鏈暴露揭露。
findings.excerpt: The rule effectively imposes export control-like restrictions on the transfer, sale, or sharing of sensitive data-including genomic, geolocation, biometric, health, financial, and other personal data-to or with entities in countries of concern, as well as entities and persons associated with those countries.

note: 網路搜尋未找到 MSTR 與關稅／出口管制／實體清單相關的來源。
